_meta.openai/annotationJustification: Updates site-level settings (title, mode, etc.) without replacing page bodies.

description: Update site settings: title, keyConvention, or editingMode ('live' = each editor save publishes immediately; 'staged' = saves stay drafts until publish_site). Slug is the hostname — change it with rename_site, not this tool. Set 'staged' before handing the editor to a person via start_edit_session's draftEditorUrl. signature toggles the "Made with Dotsy" badge ({enabled, mark: logo|dot, reveal: pill|seal}); it is live immediately. trailingSlash (ignore|never|always) sets the page URL form: the other form 301s to it and canonicals/sitemap use it; live immediately. ownSeoFiles: true lets the next publish use the site's own robots.txt that blocks the whole site (Disallow: /) and its own static sitemap.xml (replaces the generated one, collection pages included); a robots.txt without Disallow: / is used anyway. aiTrain (true or false) says whether AI training crawlers may use the live site; false asks them not to, true allows them (the default). Live immediately.

aiTrain.description: Whether AI training crawlers may use the live site. true (the default) allows them. false asks them not to. Live immediately, no publish needed. Same callers who can set trailingSlash can set this.

context.description: One sentence: why you are calling this tool and what you are trying to accomplish. Stored on the site's activity log and visible to everyone on the site — never put secrets or personal data here.

editingMode.description: How the editor's Save behaves. 'live' (default) publishes each save immediately; 'staged' keeps saves as drafts until publish_site. Prefer 'staged' when an agent will hand the editor to a person (see start_edit_session → draftEditorUrl) so keystrokes don't go straight to the public site. API writes always stage regardless of this setting.

guestToken.description: Guest token from start_site. Send it on every call until claim_site. Omit when this chat is already signed in to Dotsy.

ownSeoFiles.description: Use the site's own robots.txt and sitemap.xml even when they can hurt search: a robots.txt that blocks the whole site (Disallow: /), and a static sitemap.xml, which replaces the generated one (collection pages included). Off by default; a robots.txt without Disallow: / is always used. Takes effect at the next publish.

signature.description: "Made with Dotsy" signature badge. Takes effect on the live site immediately, no publish needed.

enabled.description: Show the badge in the bottom-right corner of every published page.

mark.description: Resting look: 'dot' (senna dot, default) or 'logo' (Dotsy logo).

reveal.description: On hover: 'seal' (rotating stamp, default) or 'pill' ("Made with Dotsy").

trailingSlash.description: Page URL form. 'ignore' (default): /blog and /blog/ both serve the page. 'never': /blog/ 301s to /blog. 'always': /blog 301s to /blog/. The canonical tag and sitemap use the same form. Live immediately, no publish needed.

name: update_site
